program: Capital Bound Moves: settlement and proof experiment
status: Stage 0 implemented; finite-budget simulation, actual Core CSV probe and existing Nova v2 proof verification executed. Full Ark/BitVM lifecycle and public Testnet4 pilot pending.

live_run_bounds.recovery_tail: continue observation until every commitment recovers; report unresolved exposure at any forced stop
live_run_bounds.budget_gate: dry-run graph and relay checks must fit limits before funding; full dispute graphs exceeding limits remain on regtest

accounting.primary_endpoint: minimum external capital achieving prespecified delivery SLO on the same offered invoice trace

delivery_slo.latency_deadline: one common application deadline across compared arms, fixed before running; record protocol confirmation and final capital recovery separately
delivery_slo.settlement_semantics: the same recipient-usable security condition across compared arms; report provisional acceptance separately

accounting.paper_duration_endpoint: funded capital-time divided by settled unique application value; report encumbered capital-time duration separately
accounting.counting_rule: one canonical reserve lot per economic funding source; virtual claims alias backing and add no second lot

arms.description: four-node diamond with explicit routes, finite channels, reserves and pending HTLC accounting
pinned unmodified Ark server with actual issuance pool, confirmed recovery, and Lightning ingress/egress
same Ark transaction/state rules with transparent Nova audit proofs; isolate proof overhead and audit benefit
batch claim or withdrawal proof with authenticated public inputs and Bitcoin-enforced payout/dispute graph; enable only after binding and recovery gates
modified-consensus research lane for the proposed keyless verifier; separate results from public testnet4 consensus

experiments.question: Does route history change unsplittable delivery while every cut remains conserved?
experiments.fixture: diamond requests s->t=1 then a->t=2; compare first path via a/b and MPP rescue

experiments.question: When is each Ark-funded sat spendable again?
Which object meets the same SLO with the least funded capital?
reserve_modes: signed imbalance with separately charged starting reserves

experiments.question: What does batching save after proof, queue and dispute costs?
Can invalid claims or unavailable data cause release or indefinite capital lock?
cases: two simultaneous assertions on one reserve

experiments.question: Do pinned standard-consensus transactions relay, confirm and recover on public testnet4?
experiments.network_gate: actual binary supports testnet4 and every script passes the unmodified node's testmempoolaccept
experiments.inference_limit: transport, script, timing and receipts; test coins provide no evidence about real capital prices

paired_design.unit_of_replication: independent topology and demand seed; invoices are repeated observations within a run
paired_design.oracle: separate hindsight upper-bound arm; deployment policies use past observations only
paired_design.analysis: paired differences and cluster bootstrap over seeds; show service and cost jointly; live pilot is feasibility evidence

require: proof verifies on the exact public statement
fixed funded outpoint survives all mutation tests
invalid payout rejected by actual transaction path
data availability and watcher duty declared
prover, verifier and challenger run as separate processes with independently checked statement and receipt inputs
reorg rollback, restart and recovery exercised on native regtest with no stale-root or duplicate payout acceptance
safe time windows and recovery plan
same offered workload and common application delivery deadline and settlement semantics
at least 10 percent reduction in encumbered capital-time as proposed practical threshold
peak external funded capital and funded capital-time do not increase; otherwise publish a Pareto tradeoff instead of an unqualified capital improvement
paired uncertainty interval excludes no improvement

evidence_labels.simulation: synthetic ledger and routing arithmetic; no Bitcoin spend or cryptographic security claim
evidence_labels.native_regtest: unmodified Bitcoin node mined transaction receipts plus separately named local proof checks
evidence_labels.public_testnet4: public transaction identifiers, block inclusion, node version and receipts; off-chain proof verification identified separately
evidence_labels.patched_regtest_only: experimental consensus; cannot promote to public testnet4 through passing local tests

claim_weight_regression.epoch_order: freeze eligible claims, validate, compute distribution, persist payout commitment, then retire mutable epoch state

implementation.native_probe_scope: signed CSV recovery and output reuse on isolated regtest; faucet excluded; no Ark or BitVM graph claim
